summary_1line: Bhishma explains the traits of malevolent people and outlines social, ritual, and moral duties concerning Brahmanas, charity, sin, and expiation.

image_candidates.scene_text: An arrogant, suspicious man sits alone greedily eating rich food while others nearby watch with hungry eyes.
A starving Brahmana quietly takes a small handful of grain from a field at dusk, intending only a single meal.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows instructing Yudhishthira about the signs of wicked men and the duties of kings.
